question: How often does the relative ordering of the same pair of traits reverse between plant families?
population: The prospectively qualified AusTraits final core; matched positive-numeric core additionally for raw-log sensitivity.
pair_rule: For every trait pair represented together in at least 2 families, compare the sign of rho_A-rho_B among families.
reversal_probability: For a trait pair with p families where A>B and q where A<B, disagreement probability for two distinct randomly selected families is 2pq/[n(n-1)], n=p+q; ties are excluded from n.
summary: Weight trait-pair reversal probabilities by the number of available unordered family pairs n(n-1)/2.
role: pre-frozen effect-size description of lineage-specific re-ranking; does not replace primary family-repeatability or rank-portability tests.

interpretation_thresholds.strong_reordering: family-pair-count-weighted reversal probability >=0.40 on both S3 and prune-only
interpretation_thresholds.substantial_reordering: weighted reversal probability >=1/3 on both axes but strong criterion not met
interpretation_thresholds.limited_or_axis_sensitive: either axis has weighted reversal probability <1/3

conjunction_replication.global_spectrum_component: pre-frozen within-family rank portability gain >0 and one-sided blocked-permutation p<=0.05 on both S3 and prune-only
conjunction_replication.reordering_component: at least substantial_reordering on both tree axes
conjunction_replication.interpretation: A replicated global trait hierarchy may coexist with frequent lineage-specific pair-order reversals.

threshold_rationale.strong_threshold_0_40: 0.40 is 80% of the theoretical maximum pair-order disagreement probability of 0.50.
threshold_rationale.substantial_threshold_one_third: 1/3 is two-thirds of the theoretical maximum and distinguishes frequent reordering from modest minority reversals.
threshold_rationale.chronology: Thresholds frozen after the BIEN exploratory discovery but before any AusTraits memory-loss outcome; they define replication strength, not discovery significance.
